title: Callback subscribers cannot be unsubscribed
reasoning: The service exposes subscribe_callback and stores callbacks in ConfigSubscriptionManager, but unsubscribe only accepts/removes protocol subscribers from _subscribers. There is no API path to remove entries from _callbacks. Any component that registers a lifecycle-bound callback cannot detach it, so stale callbacks keep receiving config updates and retained callback closures can leak resources.
recommendation: Add an unsubscribe_callback method on ConfigSubscriptionManager and ConfigurationService, or make subscribe_callback return a disposable/unsubscribe handle. Ensure callback removal uses the same identity semantics as subscription.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for callback subscription lifecycle or ensuring callbacks stop firing after disposal.
suggestedRegressionTest: Subscribe a callback, remove it through the new unsubscribe path, trigger notify_subscribers, and assert the callback is not invoked while protocol subscriber removal still works.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/core/config/subscriptions.py, backend/src/core/config/service.py, and a focused backend unit test for callback unsubscribe behavior.
